title: Solar access for adjoining sites merit assessment criteria
text: M3.8.1 Development is designed to protect solar access for neighbouring sites taking into account the potential to overshadow: i. major openings to primary living spaces, in particular those oriented between north west, north and east; ii. private open space and communal open space; and iii. roof mounted solar collectors.
notes: from: ch3 M3.9 (renumbered M3.8.1, text unchanged). Table 3.8a footnote and figure labels still cite 'Table 3.9a' / 'Figure 3.8.d' (mis-numbered).
